Filhote, deixei um Chá de Erva-Cidreira.en: Sweetie, I left a Lemon Balm Tea stored in this PC. Eat properly, sleep early and call me on Rádio Cipó. Love, Mom.

O Diário registra sozinho tudo o que voc.en: The Journal records everything you see on its own. But a complete entry only comes from catching! Every 30 species, I'll send you a researcher medal.

Bicho amigo fareja o que a gente não vê..en: A friendly critter sniffs out what we can't see. Walk with your closest partner at the front of the team and watch for the ground to sparkle.

Já tenho mais insígnias que você, viu? M.en: I already have more badges than you, you know? Just kidding. But I will! Train hard so our next battle isn't boring.

Vi você no jornal!.en: I saw you in the paper!

A cidade inteira comenta que a luz da Us.en: The whole town is saying the Power Plant's lights came back thanks to you. I put some of your patacas in savings, like we agreed. Behave on the train!

Os tuiuiús voltaram a fazer ninho na pal.en: The jabiru storks are nesting on the big stilt house again. If you come by, come see: it's thanks to you and your partners.

Tá, você ajudou lá no Farol. Fiquei deve.en: Fine, you helped out at the Lighthouse. I owe you one. Just one! I'll get even in our next battle.

As criaturas tiradas das jaulas da Mina.en: The creatures taken from the Mine's cages have been set free in the Chapada. Drop by someday: the landscape will thank you.

Perdi. Vendi o que não era meu e paguei.en: I lost. I sold what wasn't mine and paid the price. I'll be planting trees for the rest of my life, by order of the Council. Don't write to me.

O Pico Pingorama guarda o seu nome na pe.en: Pico Pingorama keeps your name in stone. But the trail doesn't end: the Floresta Ancestral has opened, and there are legends roaming free out there.
